patch_description: Crossover combining the best elements of both prior programs: (1) the diverse structured seed set from the annealing program (regular 13-gon, ellipse, 12-gon+center, 7+6 two-ring 3-fold configuration, random), (2) simulated annealing with bottleneck-vertex-focused moves (moves the vertex participating in the smallest triangle half the time, which empirically improves the min-area objective faster than uniform random moves), and (3) adaptive sigma restarts from the hill-climbing program. Time budget is capped at ~2s (matching the faster program's eval time while allowing annealing's better escape from local optima). Deterministic via fixed seed 42. Fallback to a regular 13-gon on any failure.
